subject: Packaging for SecureOps add-on, onboarding evidence & credit timing
messages:
From: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@hedgehoghealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SecureOps add-on: pricing + evidence requirements

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Hedgehog Health is interested in the SecureOps add-on (audit logs + KMS + 3yr data residency in us-west). Procurement asked for a single price line for: audit log retention 7 years, KMS/HSM access (1 HSM seat for key custody), and HIPAA attestation addition. They also want clarity on what "evidence" we can provide during onboarding vs. after go-live (SOC2 report, configuration screenshots, attestation letters).

Quick asks: 1) Can you provide a bundled price we can include in our purchase order? 2) Any standard SOW language for evidence delivery milestones? 3) Estimated timeline between PO and evidence handover (we're targeting mid-July go-live).

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if easier.

Emily Barnes
Head of Procurement, Hedgehog Health
emily.barnes@hedgehoghealth.com

--
Attachment: procurement-template.docx (ref)

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@hedgehoghealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecureOps add-on: pricing + evidence requirements

Emily —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: we can provide a bundled line for the add-on, we typically split evidence delivery across onboarding milestones (some artifacts at kick-off, final attestation after stabilization), and mid-July is feasible depending on PO timing.

Below is a proposed commercial approach we can put on the PO and a suggested evidence milestone schedule. If acceptable, I'll loop in Legal for the exact SOW language and Ben to model the concession/credit.

Proposed PO line (bundled): "SecureOps Add-on — Audit logs (7y retention), KMS/HSM (1 HSM seat), HIPAA attestation — $120,000 annual" — billed monthly or annually per your preference.

Evidence milestone (recommended):
- Week 0 (kick-off): Configuration checklist + onboarding plan (attestation: Redwood confirms configuration to meet Hedgehog controls)
- Week 2–4: Delivery of SOC2 snapshot, audit-log configuration screenshots, KMS access confirmation (operational evidence)
- Post-30 days of production: Final HIPAA attestation letter and detailed evidence pack

We can conflate some deliverables if you need the attestation earlier; typical path is final attestation after 30 days to validate production baseline.

Next steps: if you confirm bundle price cadence (annual vs monthly) and PO ETA, Ben will propose a credit schedule for implementation work (one-time onboarding credit applied over first 3 months).

Happy to jump on a quick call — propose Thu 10am PT?

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: SOW-SecureOps-v1.1.pdf (draft)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-20T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecureOps add-on: pricing + evidence requirements

Team —

Reviewed Marcus' bundle. A couple of commercial notes and an alternative credit structure for procurement to consider:

1) Price: $120k/yr baseline is defensible for a three-feature bundle at Hedgehog scale, but procurement will ask about credits for implementation and evidence delivery.
2) Implementation credit options (pick one):
   a) Upfront implementation credit: $18k credit on first invoice (one-time) — simplest for PO accounting.
   b) Amortized credit: $6k/month off the first 3 invoices — better aligns with revenue recognition and gives procurement a steady concession.
   c) Milestone credit tied to evidence: $9k after onboarding checklist complete, $9k after SOC2 snapshot delivered.

3) KMS/HSM note: if Hedgehog requires an HSM with customer-managed keys in their own cloud tenancy, that becomes an "integration" SOW line (engineering time). Recommend we keep one HSM seat in our managed HSM for price simplicity and include an optional pass-through if they insist on BYOK (Trevor from SecureCloud can confirm feasibility).

If procurement needs a single PO line, suggest we propose the $120k annual with an explicit note in the SOW describing the credit option (a/b/c) and indicate which will be applied upon PO. I'll draft sample SOW wording for the credit table.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-breakdown-20270519.csv

From: Emily Barnes <emily.barnes@hedgehoghealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: trevor@securecloud.io
Date: 2027-05-20T11:09:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecureOps add-on: pricing + evidence requirements

Thanks Marcus / Ben — this helps a lot. A few clarifications from procurement/security:

- Procurement preference: single annual PO line is easiest. They will accept an amortized credit but want it spelled out in the SOW.
- Security ask: Hedgehog prefers customer BYOK for regulatory reasons; Trevor (cc'd) is our cloud security lead — can you confirm if Redwood supports BYOK for the HSM seat, or if we must use Redwood-managed keys? If BYOK requires a separate integration fee, we need that number for the PO.
- Evidence timing: mid-July is firm for go-live; do you have a rapid-path where attestation can be provided at go-live (i.e., not waiting 30 days)? If not, we need a signed commitment that attestation will follow within 30 days and a workaround (temporary attestation addendum) for the PO.

We can sign the PO next week provided we get: 1) confirmed single-line price with credit schedule noted in SOW, 2) BYOK feasibility + one-off integration estimate, 3) statement on attestation timing.

Emily

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, trevor@securecloud.io
Date: 2027-05-21T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SecureOps add-on: pricing + evidence requirements

Emily / Trevor —

Thanks — short answers and next steps below.

1) Single-line PO we will propose: "SecureOps Add-on (Audit logs 7y, KMS/HSM 1 seat, HIPAA attestation) — $120,000/yr". In the SOW we'll include the credit option selected. Per procurement preference, we'll default to amortized credit unless procurement asks for upfront.

2) BYOK/HSM: Trevor, quick note — Redwood's managed HSM supports BYOK in two modes: (A) Customer-managed keys hosted in your cloud tenancy (BYOK final mode) which requires an integration effort (estimated one-time engineering fee: $25,000), or (B) Redwood-managed HSM with customer key-import capability (no integration fee; Redwood performs the import under joint controls). For regulated customers wanting strict custody, we recommend mode (A). We can provide a short scoping call to confirm details.

3) Attestation timing: We can commit to a signed attestation addendum delivered at go-live and final HIPAA attestation after 30 days of production stabilization. SOW language will say: "Redwood will deliver a provisional attestation letter at go-live certifying configuration and controls; final attestation to follow after 30 days of stable production." That should satisfy procurement while giving our security team the validation window.

Attachments: I attached a draft SOW (SOW-SecureOps-v1.1.pdf), a pricing CSV with option breakdown, and an evidence checklist template (evidence-checklist-hedgehog.xlsx).

Next operations:
- Emily: if you confirm the $120k annual and that Redwood should apply amortized credit (Ben's option b), we'll update the SOW and send final PO-ready language and DocuSign packet by EOD tomorrow.
- Trevor: can you confirm whether Hedgehog will proceed with BYOK mode (A) or accept Redwood-managed key-import (B)? If mode (A), we'll include the $25k integration line in the PO.

Happy to set a 20-minute sync if helpful.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW-SecureOps-v1.1.pdf, evidence-checklist-hedgehog.xlsx, pricing-breakdown-20270519.csv
